economies.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

value.label: Experimental estimate of the exporter's value (FOB): the importer's report, converted to FOB and adjusted with the two economies' reports of the same flow in other years, combined with the exporter's own report of the previous or next year, and corrected for the current year's average difference between the two reports

codes.M: experimental estimate from the importer's report
codes.E: experimental estimate; no report on either side, based on the same pair's other years

backtest.design: exporter-years hidden at random (10 groups); predicted from importers' reports

names.S1: importer's value, CIF converted to FOB

backtest.target_note: test rows re-weighted to the flows actually estimated (2024 or not x pair history x size); past_only_history matches 2024 and economies that stopped reporting
backtest.wape_definition: sum |estimate - true| / sum true over rows with an exporter value > 0 (rows where the exporter recorded nothing are left out; see sum_ratio_all)

notes: Experimental estimates, shown only in the estimated view; reported values are unchanged.
An estimate is the value the exporter would probably have recorded, not a true value.

Range: 90% range of test errors for similar flows (product family, size, pair history). The lower bound is 0 where exporters often record nothing. The range is for the exporter's value and can lie below the importer's figure.
Country totals: ranges from test errors of whole-year totals of similar size and history.
Upper ends of ranges are cut at 1,000x the estimate (a few flows below USD 10,000).
Each year's estimates are corrected by the year's average difference between exporters' reports and their estimates on pairs where both reported (2024: about -7%).
2024 data are provisional; 2024 estimates for pairs whose importer figure rose sharply are probably still too high. Ranges are calibrated over all years.
No-report estimates are built only on reported figures of neighbouring years.
No conversion between HS versions: estimates keep the importer's HS code.

codes.C: UN Comtrade's own estimate, kept (with a range)
codes.K: from the quantity field (net weight empty)
codes.B: model estimate; the partner's reports of this pair are used
codes.U: model estimate without a partner weight
codes.Q: reported weight replaced after a quality check

weight.world_totals: weight_est_world.parquet (sum of economy totals; bounds combined as independent)
